name: SnowLion HomeStay
description:
Property Highlights
The Snowlion Homestay is located on Gandhi Road and is just a few miles away from the nearest airport.
The homestay has 12 spacious, comfortable, and cosy rooms.
The large bay and windows make it more awesome to look at the ranges of the Himalayas.
The Snowlion Homestay has a small porch in front with a triangular roof structure. The building is brick finished.
The homestay is owned by a Tibetan family who lives on the topmost floor of the property itself.
The homestay's common area is Lounge, Reception, Library, Balcony Terrace, and sitting area.
Guests can opt for a Deluxe Double Room.
The property offers Roof Top Attic Suit with Open Terrace.
The homestay provides breakfast according to the guests' requirements.
The rooms are very spacious and have a Double Bed.
It also provides round a clock room service and an attached bathroom with all essential toiletries.
All rooms have a TV and free WIFI.
The rooms are non-smoking rooms.

name: Laliguras Homestay Gorkhey
description:
🌿 Your Himalayan escape is waiting! 🏔️

Leave the city behind and experience the peaceful charm of Laliguras Homestay, Gorkhey — where rivers, pine forests, mountain views, and warm hospitality come together.

✨ Stay Includes
🍽️ 4 Delicious Meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snacks + Chai Pakora & Dinner)
🏡 Cozy village homestay
🌊 Riverside walks
🥾 Local sightseeing & Samanden trek
🔥 Bonfire & local food experiences

🍛 Don’t miss our authentic Nepali Thali and delicious homemade local dishes.

📍 Route:
NJP → Jorethang → Pattharay (Bhareng) → 45-minute scenic walk to Laliguras Homestay

💰 Starting from:
🥗 ₹1,000/person/night (Veg)
🍗 ₹1,200/person/night (Non-Veg)


Come for the mountains. Stay for the memories. ❤️🌲

name: Himalayan Cloud's Homestay
description:
“Some places are not just stays… they become a feeling you carry back home. 🌙✨
As night falls, Himalayan Clouds Homestay turns into a peaceful mountain retreat wrapped in silence, fresh air, and warm lights glowing through the hills. Away from the city noise, every evening here feels calm, soulful, and close to nature.
